prompt.project_info: Create an authentic iPhone-style candid portrait of an approved adult man in an evening parking lot.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man in an oversized light beige sweatshirt and black baseball cap with subtle stitching. He lifts the cap brim with one hand, turns three-quarter toward camera, and smiles naturally.
prompt.composition_elements: Chest-up 3:4 framing, slightly below eye level, low modern brick building and parked cars behind, relaxed urban surroundings, slightly tilted amateur horizon.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft late-afternoon/early-evening daylight, even shadows, natural contrast, moderate grain and friendly candid mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic iPhone-style image, 3:4 vertical, shallow depth of field, realistic skin pores, hair strands, fabric, hands, and JPEG grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an authentic photorealistic 3:4 iPhone-style candid portrait of an approved adult man in an oversized light beige sweatshirt and black baseball cap. He lifts the cap brim with one hand, turns three-quarter toward camera, and gives a wide natural smile. Frame him chest-up slightly below eye level in an evening parking lot near a low modern brick building with parked cars. Use soft natural light, slight horizon tilt, shallow depth, realistic skin and fabric texture, moderate grain, and unedited color.
